issues.title: Bootstrap Mura Companion 0.9 source snapshot
issues.body:
Mura Companion has advanced to **0.9 — Paired Transport / Live Visits**.

Current local development snapshot: `19846baa48e9dd3ee1e8532d4450c6da4b9aaf80`.

Validated locally:
- 120/120 unit tests pass
- JavaScript syntax checks pass
- Character Pack validation passes (Mura, 20 actions)
- `git diff --check` passes

0.9 adds:
- signed `.mura-pair` / `.mura-pair-accept` device pairing
- per-device X25519 transport identities protected by LocalSecretStore
- peer-vector delta sync in encrypted `.mura-delta` packets using X25519 + HKDF-SHA256 + AES-256-GCM
- replay windows, sequence tracking, out-of-order-safe idempotent merge and peer revocation
- per-peer + per-packet personal-memory opt-in
- acknowledged-event compaction with a recent safety window
- ciphertext-only blind-relay capsule primitive; no hosted relay service yet
- signed `.mura-live-invite` / `.mura-live-arrival` handshake for known companions
- sandboxed click-through guest presence with only presence/greet/gesture authority
- full-identity import clears active peer authority when establishing a new replica baseline
- memory schema v8 with transport/live boundaries

The GitHub `main` README and protocol/design docs are being updated to 0.9. The complete runnable source + art snapshot remains available as the local ZIP/Git bundle because the connected repository interface is not a convenient bulk binary transport. Real macOS/Windows Electron acceptance testing is still pending.

1.0 — Companion Platform / Hardening
Character Pack: authored directional pointing + seated edge pose for Mura
issues.display_title: Character Pack: authored directional pointing + seated edge pose for Mura

discussion.body:
Progress 2026-09-28: five candidate source poses have now been generated and visually reviewed outside the repository: point-left, point-right, point-up, point-down, and sit-edge. point-right initially pointed the wrong way and was corrected in a separate edit pass. All candidates were normalized to 192×208 transparent PNG previews; sit-edge visibly bends hips/knees with both lower legs hanging below the ledge.

These are **candidates, not yet canonical assets**. They are not merged because the current Adobe → GitHub connector boundary does not expose the final binary PNG bytes to the GitHub connector in this session. Do not close this issue until the actual binaries are committed, visually compared against the current Mura pack, added to the manifest/bundle, and the Character Pack validator passes.

Next acceptance step: commit the five binaries as first-party assets, review identity consistency at native size and ~86 px, then integrate into FOLKOOP and remove the temporary orange directional cue / lean-in approximation.
